title: Danda Nata: listening beyond the stage
coverage_gap: No dedicated Danda Nata narrative found in the map/KB search. Bata Osha source title containing Danda Pahanra is a different context and is not reused as Danda Nata evidence.

sources.title: Government of Odisha — Ganjam District Gazetteer
sources.locator: Printed pp.459–460 and 463 (PDF pp.475–476 and 479): Danda Nata and Danda Yatra entries. Text and page images inspected. Describes Ganjam; repeated entries are one source, not independent corroboration. Upload-path dates are not treated as the edition date.

sources.title: Aswini Kumar Mishra — Dandanata: The Performative Dance
sources.locator: Odisha Review, April 2022, pp.62–69; especially pp.64–65 on names, ritual and theatre, and p.68 on instruments. PDF text inspected through the web reader. An authored interpretation; its ancient-origin claims and calendar wording are not adopted as established facts.

claim_boundaries: No ancient-origin date, universal membership rule, present-day troupe availability or fixed ensemble inferred.
Theatre roles are not evidence of performer identities.
Madal is not silently equated with Mardala.
2022 calendar wording is inconsistent and is not used; dated district account is not a current event schedule.
Source generalizations about caste, community or decline are not adopted. No ritual ordeal instructions or claimed health effects.
Listening prompts are editorial guidance. No audio, lyrics or source images republished.
